substantive_reconstruction.cut_certificate_and_target: For each p+s=N the actual integer sample index is 2^s*x+y, with the suffix restricted to Fin(2^s). HermiteSampleStructure applies the full affine threshold/polynomial separation to that literal grid and returns an existential A,B through HermiteBond k, whose cardinality is 8k+12; rank_le follows because the column space is in the span of A's columns. Dividing A by the true positive sample norm preserves the factorization. That operation substitutes a scalar expression, not an evaluated-normalizer/circuit record. Actual sampled amplitudes are strictly positive, so the nonempty 2^N table has Z>0. When N=0, Z=a_0>0 and the sole amplitude is1; the reference loader's actual base branch is the empty circuit. No zero-vector premise is hidden.
substantive_reconstruction.all_cut_to_short_exact_real_circuit: The positive existence route is sound and additional to independent cut witnesses. Iteratively factor flattened tensors by exact real SVD; the previously chosen prefix isometry is injective, so removing it preserves the residual flattening ranks, which equal the relevant ordered cut ranks. This produces compatible TT cores with endpoint bonds1 and internal dimensions at most D, not an arbitrary stitching of unrelated A,B. Right-canonicalization gives orthonormal rows, equivalently input-column isometries into one emitted qubit and the next bond; the normalized scalar-boundary residual can be absorbed into the first core. Pad each active bond into B=2^ceil(log2(max(1,D))) with B<2D for D>1 (actual D>=12). There are at most B required columns in a 2B-dimensional local space, so orthogonal/unitary completion exists; unused columns permit orientation correction without altering the required action. N local stages, each compilable with polynomially many exact-real one/two-qubit gates in B, yield polynomial size in N,D and O(log D) reusable clean bond wires. The last active bond is scalar, so the bond returns to zero. The candidate explicitly preserves the necessary word/site-to-little-endian reindexing. It neither charges computing arbitrary real angles nor claims a new cut-rank-to-TT Lean theorem.
substantive_reconstruction.rank_one_boundary: For normalized nonzero N>1, the first ordered cut of rank1 gives psi=u tensor v, with u,v made unit by moving a nonzero scalar/sign between them. At a later cut the full flattening is the corresponding residual flattening multiplied/tensored by nonzero u; this injective embedding preserves rank. Thus v has rank1 at every internal residual cut, and induction ends at one-qubit factors. N=1 is the vacuous-cut base case. Each real normalized (alpha,beta) is exactly the first column of [[alpha,-beta],[beta,alpha]], an arbitrary-angle RY gate; a global real sign can be absorbed into one factor for N>=1. This is O(N) nonuniform exact-real preparation, independent of effective encodability. Bell12 tensor Bell34 instead has rank1 only at12|34 and rank2 at the two other internal cuts, so the candidate's one-cut discriminator is correct.
substantive_reconstruction.genuine_effective_input_obstruction: Choose a noncomputable q in(1/4,3/4). The displayed first-qubit state tensor |+> on the remaining sites is normalized, product across every cut and still has an O(N) arbitrary-real circuit. If a finite no-oracle program produced fixed-computable-gate approximations for every requested accuracy, one could compute the first-qubit-zero probability of each finite output circuit. For normalized vectors and projector P, |<psi,Ppsi>-<phi,Pphi>|<=2||psi-phi||; requesting extra bits and evaluating the output circuit to comparable precision computes q, contradiction. The statement is a missing-effective-input-promise example: it does not purport to encode this q as an allowed finite input. It supplies no lower bound on arbitrary-real gate count and no hardness result for the actual Hermite samples. Merely computable entries similarly imply no polynomial evaluation bound without an explicit access/runtime promise.

substantive_reconstruction.finite_bit_boundary: The requested uniform model additionally needs an effective L/coefficient/core representation with charged access; algorithms for normalized compatible stage data, evaluated norm/relative precision and real gate parameters; fixed-finite-gate synthesis; global approximation propagation and conditioning; and a runtime in N,k,b and input length. Normalization can amplify raw absolute errors when a norm is small, so the norm/error obligation is real even though exact positivity is proved. Neither Lean's noncomputable annotation nor the certificate's own disclaimer proves inefficiency or incomputability.
